name: Toolbar
purpose: Group related commands in one ARIA toolbar with orientation-aware roving keyboard focus.
useWhen: A compact row or column of related application controls should behave as one keyboard group.

avoidWhen.condition: The items navigate among pages or are unrelated standalone actions.

composition: Compose Button, Link, Separator, and ToggleGroup/ToggleItem parts inside a named Root; keep all toolbar items in logical DOM order.

rules.statement: Use Group for named subgroups without a second roving scope. Input participates in the same toolbar; keep one input last in horizontal toolbars so native editing arrows remain available and Tab exits. Root disabled overrides descendants; focusableWhenDisabled on Button preserves discovery without activation.
Give the toolbar and icon-only controls useful accessible names.
Let Toolbar own item registration and arrow-key focus rather than adding competing tabIndex or key handlers.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using AppBar.Toolbar as an ARIA toolbar or nesting a second roving-focus implementation.
commonMistakes.correction: Compose Toolbar.Root inside AppBar when grouped controls need toolbar behavior.

validation: Test orientation, arrows, Home/End, root disabled, focusableWhenDisabled buttons, toggle state, links, native input editing, Tab entry/exit, cancellation, iframe ownership and RTL.
Confirm Group naming and separator orientation/decorative semantics and forwarded refs.
